name: Crystal Forests
description: Silicate growths that hum at radio frequencies. Excellent for research.

name: Geothermal Vents
description: Free heat and free power for anyone willing to build near them.

name: Ancient Ruins
description: Someone lived here first. Their leavings are worth studying and worth boasting about.

name: Fertile Delta
description: Rich alluvial soil fed by a continent-spanning river system.

name: Dust Veins
description: Seams of raw Dust run close to the surface.

name: Toxic Atmosphere
description: Breathing here is a slow way to die. Nobody is happy about it.

name: Tectonic Instability
description: Quakes level factories faster than they can be rebuilt.

name: Ring System
description: A spectacular ring of ice and rock that doubles as a mining ground.

name: Hollow Core
description: Vast natural caverns offer extra living space below ground.

name: Bioluminescent Seas
description: The oceans glow at night. Tourists and fishermen both approve.

name: Magnetic Storms
description: Instruments fail, lights flicker and tempers fray.

name: The Monolith
description: A featureless black obelisk of unknown origin. Pilgrims arrive uninvited.
